lab.title: Lab
lab.intro: Benchmark runs and strategy experiments, read-only. Changes are tested here on frozen labelled datasets and only a human approval (command line) can promote one. What the lab agent writes is untrusted input. Nothing here starts it: run from its sandbox (<cmd/>, a Windows AppContainer) it cannot write your data or read your credentials; started any other way, only an in-process guard keeps it away from your data.
